description: 3-to-8 combinational decoder with one-hot output behavior.

behavior.description: Drives exactly one output bit high according to the 3-bit input value.
rules: For input integer N from 0 through 7, y[N] = 1.
For input integer N from 0 through 7, every output bit other than y[N] = 0.
Exactly one output bit is high for every valid 3-bit input.
